title: MemoryReceiptsGetResponse
description: Success payload for memory.receipts.get (§7.28). Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.receipts.get (§7.28): NOT_FOUND, RECEIPT_EXPIRED, NOT_AUTHORIZED. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.

receipt.description: Polled receipt constrained to the emitting op contract: one branch per mutating op keyed on the op string, reusing the per-op result shapes (§7.0.3, §7.28). Sync op receipts admit committed/failed; the four §7.0.3 async op receipts admit committed/pending/failed.

error.description: Memory error envelope: shared ErrorEnvelope plus required details.retry_class (§14.1–14.2).
